intro: ^Rain hammers the elevated walkways of District 7 as you step out of the transit pod, neon light smearing across wet ferrocrete.
^Your contact said Pier 14, no later than midnight. You're early.
^Drone traffic hums overhead, light for a Tuesday. Three ways out of this walkway if it goes bad.
scope_area: ^You linger under a noodle stall's awning, watching the pier from a distance. Drone traffic is light tonight. No obvious watchers.
pier: ^Pier 14 is quiet except for the slap of water against the pilings. A figure in a rain-slicked coat waits near a shuttered cargo container.
^Something about the way they're standing reads as trained, not comfortable.
^Read the figure's stance before you move (CHECK Streetwise 8)
recognize_contact: ^You clock the posture before the face — ex-corpo security, now freelance. This is your contact.
^"You're late," they say. "Or early. Hard to tell with you."
tense_approach: ^You can't place them. Corpo enforcer? Rival fixer? You close the distance carefully, one hand near your jacket.
^Whatever this turns into, you can take it.
^They watch you approach without moving. Then their hand drops to their hip.
combat_won: ^The enforcer drops. You catch your breath, pulse hammering, and check the pier. Still quiet.
combat_lost: ^Pain blooms white behind your eyes. The last thing you register is the wet ferrocrete rushing up to meet you.
